LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SUBJECT- VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement, part of Strand 14 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: which the rule of subject-verb agreement has been applied, • share the sentences in charts for peer review. How do we construct sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read texts on varied topics such as outdoor games and identify the subject and verbs in the sentences,

2. brainstorm and make short notes on the relationship between a subject and a verb in a sentence in terms of number and person,

3. read sentences and label subject- verb agreement in them,

4. make sentences based on outdoor sports in

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read texts on varied topics such as outdoor games and identify the subject and verbs in the sentences,
2. brainstorm and make short notes on the relationship between a subject and a verb in a sentence in terms of number and person,
3. read sentences and label subject- verb agreement in them,
4. make sentences based on outdoor sports in

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Collaboration: It is enhanced by the learner recognising the value of others' ideas when sharing sentences on charts for

peer review.

Values:
Love is enhanced as the learner shows a caring attitude while peer reviewing peers’ sentences.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Value for sports is enhanced as the learner reads texts on varied topics such outdoor games.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of subject-verb agreement when editing their written work in subjects such as Integrated Science

and Pre-Technical Studies.
